_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP9 F4, live leg (source = scene presence, route: no model). LANE ONLY, x2 consecutive on one lane, never retuned. Preconditions as v25-09-witness.json (dev bundle served, lane group with DM Narrator, Arin and Ponticius, run header captured first). Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes <n> --repeat 2 --strict --group <lane group id> test/scenarios/v25-09-witness-f4.json. Four scenes of five real player turns; /cp activate moves the scene and its cast_changes move who is enabled (the presence source's input). The filter records, per message, the story roster members enabled at the moment ST rendered it, plus the speaker. The record so-sp9-f4 keeps the transcript and the presence column SEPARATELY. Labelling is blind: the labeller writes who was in earshot for the first 40 messages from the transcript alone (test/journeys/records/v2.5-plan09/SP9/f4-labels-run<k>.json, {index: [names]}), without opening the presence column, and scores with scoreWitnessAgreement (src/runtime/spikes/witnessFilter.ts). PASS needs >= 0.9 on both runs. The group's disabled_members is SHARED and outlives the sandbox (debug-scripts rules): the reunion scene enables Arin and Ponticius again, and the run header diff must show the cast unchanged; if a run fails mid-way, re-enable both members after the sandbox chat is deleted.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const spikes = globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes; if (!spikes) throw new Error('storyOrchestratorSpikes is missing: SP9 needs the dev bundle (npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev)'); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((name) => name.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; if (!root?.settings) throw new Error('story-orchestrator settings are not loaded'); const previous = root.settings.spikes ?? null; root.settings.spikes = { ...(previous ?? {}), witnessFilter: true }; const flags = await spikes.refresh(); if (!flags.witnessFilter || !globalThis.storyOrchestratorWitness) throw new Error(`the witness filter did not start: ${JSON.stringify(flags)}`); globalThis.__sp9 = { previous, captures: [], listener: null }; return { flags };

send_generate.text: A courier hands me a sealed letter in the guild hall. I read it aloud to everyone.
Ponticius, does the guild owe the harbour office anything?
Arin, what do you make of the seal?
I quietly ask Arin, so only she hears, whether the handwriting looks forged.
Ponticius, please check the ledgers in your office.

steps.eval: const result = await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/cp activate yard', { handleParserErrors: false }); if (result?.isError) throw new Error(result.errorMessage); return { scene: 'yard' };

send_generate.text: I step into the yard with Arin and look at the broken cart.
Arin, is that the harbour mark on the cart?
I ask the driver where he is headed.
I tell Arin to keep an eye on the driver.
I leave Arin in the yard and walk to the office.

steps.eval: const result = await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/cp activate office', { handleParserErrors: false }); if (result?.isError) throw new Error(result.errorMessage); return { scene: 'office' };

send_generate.text: I knock and enter Ponticius's office.
Ponticius, what do the ledgers say?
I tell Ponticius the letter looks forged.
I look out of the office window at the yard.
I head back to the hall to gather everyone.

steps.eval: const result = await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/cp activate reunion', { handleParserErrors: false }); if (result?.isError) throw new Error(result.errorMessage); return { scene: 'reunion' };

send_generate.text: Everyone is back in the hall. I tell them what we found.
Arin, where did the driver go?
Ponticius, can the guild spare guards for the vault?
I lay out the plan for tonight.
We agree to move at midnight.

steps.eval: const rows = globalThis.storyOrchestratorWitness.export(); if (rows.length < 40) throw new Error(`F4 needs 40 messages, the chat holds ${rows.length}`); const record = { at: new Date().toISOString(), chatId: SillyTavern.getContext().chatId, route: 'presence (no model)', transcript: rows.map((row) => ({ index: row.index, speaker: row.speaker, text: row.text })), presence: rows.map((row) => ({ index: row.index, presence: row.presence })) }; localStorage.setItem('so-sp9-f4', JSON.stringify(record)); return { messages: rows.length, unknown: rows.filter((row) => row.presence === null).length };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const state = globalThis.__sp9; if (state?.listener) ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, state.listener); globalThis.storyOrchestratorWitness?.clearAuthored(); const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; if (state && root?.settings) root.settings.spikes = state.previous ?? { witnessFilter: false }; if (root?.settings?.spikes) root.settings.spikes.witnessFilter = false; const flags = await globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.refresh(); delete globalThis.__sp9; return { restored: Boolean(state), flags };
